authoring: Source-informed contract frozen before inspecting this workflow's report bodies or native firewall records. Existing census proposals remain unchanged.
goal: Make actual denied network traffic observable through accurate, traceable domain-frequency reporting, without confusing configured policy domains with observed blocked requests.

selection.discovery: Complete retained Discussion inventory, not proof of publication-time body accuracy or native tool effects.
selection.rule: Inspect the latest three original-creation-time-ordered, title-matched Daily Firewall Report Discussions created before cutoff. Preserve every selected disposition; do not replace a selected failure with an older success.

fullAcceptance: Independently establish the actual source/runtime, reporting window and complete eligible run population, including historical assignment requirements applicable at the selected runtime.
Independently reconstruct actual allowed and denied request events, distinct domains and applicable rule attribution; compare every required reported aggregate and per-workflow detail.
Establish required chart delivery, complete or explicitly disclosed truncated coverage and source-defined output constraints.
Do not treat a successful run, report, chart, issue or firewall policy declaration as evidence of actual observed requests.

nativePartial.unit: independently corroborated reported blocked-domain frequency facts
nativePartial.formula: For each selected surviving report, count distinct explicitly reported domain/frequency cells whose exact nonnegative integer frequency and scope match independently retained original firewall request events from the bound source/runtime and reporting interval.
requirements: Bind each original report and original event artifact to exact immutable repository/run/source identities.
Derive event semantics from the actual firewall producer contract, not report prose, configured allow/deny domain sets or an agent-generated summary.
Require complete independently retained event coverage for the specific cell's declared scope; never present a sampled frequency as a whole-window count.
Deduplicate event identities and reported cells; known subtotals are not full accepted reporting periods.
nativePartial.allocation: Original report-creation cohort, once, in disjoint half-open weekly delivery periods. After-cutoff surviving bodies cannot establish original publication-time accuracy.
nativePartial.unknown: Missing original event bytes, event custody, exact scope, historical source or complete cell coverage yields null, not zero and not completed native coverage.

separateUnknowns: Security legitimacy of blocked services or allowlisting recommendations
Complete full-goal acceptance and editorial usefulness
Receipt-verified workflow contribution and sole causation
Costs and an agreed keep/change bar
Source-absent intervals between historical deletion and reintroduction
execution: Read-only original acquisition and deterministic local inspection only. No target code, workflow dispatch, remote writes or authority changes.
